delete.summary: Delete a VM and its disks

post.summary: Move a VM to another host; live when running
Restore a snapshot; the VM must be stopped

post.description: Minimum role: operator. Takes a crash-consistent snapshot of every disk (application-consistent when the guest agent is running). Keep the latest session as the base for the next incremental backup and delete older ones.

get.description: Minimum role: operator. Without base: allocated data of the whole disk. With base: data written since that session. Zero extents read as zeros in this session and may be applied as holes.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: An earlier session id of the same VM.

get.description: Minimum role: operator. Supports HTTP Range requests; read the data extents from the change map.

post.summary: Define a network and create it on hosts in scope

put.summary: Update a network definition and apply it

delete.summary: Delete a network from all hosts

token.description: Personal API token from Argus Manager (user menu > API tokens). It acts with the owner's current role and scope; read-only tokens allow GET only.

restartRequired.description: Hardware changes are waiting for the next restart

image.description: Image name, or tpl:<template> to clone a host template

userData.description: cloud-init user data; overrides the guest fields

windows.description: Sysprep customisation for a generalised Windows image; replaces the cloud-init fields

timeZone.description: Windows time zone ID, default UTC

virtio.description: Image has VirtIO drivers; otherwise SATA and e1000e are used

parent.description: Snapshot this one was taken from; empty for a root

current.description: The VM's current state descends from this snapshot

VMUpdate.description: Only the fields given are changed. CPU and memory changes on a running VM apply at its next restart (restartRequired).

scopes.description: Datacenters or datacenter/cluster; empty for every host

warning.description: Set when some hosts could not apply the change

Form.description: The fields of the matching UI form. Booleans set checkboxes, arrays repeat a field, and "prompt" answers the UI's input prompt.

source.description: any, tag:T, net:N, host:H, vm:HOST/NAME or cidr:C
